# Ontario Furnace Rebates

> Ontario Furnace Rebates is an independent furnace & HVAC rebate concierge that helps Ontario homeowners find, estimate, and claim every rebate they qualify for on furnaces, air conditioners, and heat pumps.

Ontario Furnace Rebates is the free, independent place for Ontario homeowners to estimate furnace, AC and heat pump rebates, check eligibility, and get matched with a registered contractor who handles the application.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://ontariofurnacerebates.ca/): Ontario Furnace Rebates is an independent furnace & HVAC rebate concierge that helps Ontario homeowners find, estimate, and claim every rebate they qualify for on furnaces, air conditioners, and heat pumps.
- [How It Works](https://ontariofurnacerebates.ca/how-it-works/): The three-step process for checking eligibility, matching with a registered contractor, and getting paid.
- [Who Qualifies](https://ontariofurnacerebates.ca/who-qualifies/): Eligibility requirements by home, fuel type, equipment, and contractor submission rules.
- [Rebates Explained](https://ontariofurnacerebates.ca/rebates-explained/): Overview of Ontario furnace & HVAC rebate programs and how they can stack.
- [Rebate Calculator](https://ontariofurnacerebates.ca/rebate-calculator/): Free 60-second estimate for Ontario homeowners.
- [FAQ](https://ontariofurnacerebates.ca/faq/): Direct answers about rebate amounts, audits, deadlines, payments, and oil-heated homes.
- [About](https://ontariofurnacerebates.ca/about/): Why Ontario Furnace Rebates is independent and how the free matching service works.
